summary: Iteration 2 backend testing complete. All 14 pytest tests pass (100%). Verified new features: (1) manual cell edits create schedule_audit rows with source='manual', shift_before=null on first write and equals previous shift on second write; (2) GET /api/schedule/audit is admin-only (403 for personil) and correctly filters by month/year prefix; (3) approving a request creates one audit row per day in the range with source='request-approve' and shift_after equal to request.type; (4) rejecting a request creates no audit rows and does not modify schedules; (5) PATCH /api/requests/{id} response contains status/admin_note/decided_at; (6) email dispatch to Emergent proxy returns 202 Accepted and is non-blocking. No regressions: login, register, /api/personil CRUD, /api/schedule generate+get, /api/settings GET/PATCH, /api/stats all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~680 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider modularizing email/, routers/schedule.py, routers/requests.py in future iteration.
CORS_ORIGINS is '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Should be explicit origins if cookies/credentials are ever used.
Audit endpoint requires both month and year to filter (`if month and year`); passing only one silently returns all data. Consider validating pair or documenting behavior.
log_audit swallows no exceptions — if audit insert fails, the whole request fails. Acceptable for correctness but consider try/except with logging to make audit non-blocking like email.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ prefixed personil per session; created schedule entries in 2027-03, 2027-04, 2027-05, 2027-06 and schedule generation for 2025-12.
